src: VERIFY: build gates, connected tests f06/f10, emulator screenshots Hub + Weight, visual judge vs mock frames
text:
DONE — 2026-09-13. All 16 findings remediated; both Parts + owner re-review screenshots verified.

Part A (:core:designsystem): ProvenanceChip re-anatomized (provenance word + ONE trailing info icon; repeated value and kind glyph removed; icon tints to state color when tappable); new WloCardHeader (uppercase letterspaced micro-label + provenance slot top-right — the mock's card-header pattern); new WloHeroStat (hero numeral via DerivedValue + small baseline-aligned unit suffix + delta slot — no String overload, D6 kept); new WloButton/WloSecondaryButton (real M3 Button/OutlinedButton, 48 dp floor, centered labels) to replace the bordered-Surface fake buttons; SelectChip re-based on M3 FilterChip; WloTrendChart given a legible scale (11 sp text-secondary axis numerals, lo/hi gridlines, date-range caption) and its internal duplicate "trend now" row removed; label style corrected to 11 sp per DESIGN-SYSTEM §2.

Part B (surfaces): Hub trend card rebuilt to mock parity — "Weight trend" header + derived chip top-right (opens a real EWMA/α/window explainer), 77.1 kg hero + unit + −0.2 kg/7 d delta chip inline, 30-day sparkline + "Last 30 days · tap for history", tap-through kept. NUMBER INTEGRITY: root cause was three different EWMA windows (30-day cached day-projection on Hub vs 90-day live recompute on Weight vs 14-day delta) — replaced by one canonical currentTrend(profileId, toDay) on WeighInRepository (EWMA, R-A2 α 0.15, exactly toDay−29..toDay); appendWeighIn now persists its projection scalar THROUGH the same function, both VMs read it, tuner output demoted to a labeled preview. JVM proof: CurrentTrendTest (5 tests, incl. projection == shared read; EWMA within 0.14 kg of raw). Weight page: duplication killed (one header, one stat), leaked rationale line deleted, all fake buttons → real M3 buttons with sentence-case labels ("Weigh in", "How the math works", "Body-fat methods"), BodyFatScreen converted too. Hub diary card: month heatmap REMOVED per owner decision (supersedes R-D4 on this card; component kept for F09), replaced with the mock's week-dots row. All ⓘ chips on Hub + Weight wired to real explainer content — no dead info marks on these surfaces. Seed fixture regenerated (45 d, 78.2→77.0, ±0.35 noise): trend 77.14 vs raw 77.0 — 0.14 kg gap, sensible. Follow-up ribbon fix by orchestrator: the progress band's per-point vertical strokes (rendered as a bar field on dense data) replaced with one smooth filled band, uniform valence-free color, 0.22 alpha.

VERIFY results: :core:data jvmTest 52/52; full connectedDebugAndroidTest 55/55, 0 failures; ktlint + detekt green on all touched modules; :core:designsystem:build + :app:installDebug green after the ribbon fix. Screenshots (final): /tmp/wlo-uifix/hub.png, /tmp/wlo-uifix/weight.png, /tmp/wlo-uifix/weight2.png. Note for owner: there is NO production seeder — demo data exists only via the androidTest SeedingRobot, so a real install starts empty at onboarding (correct for production; say the word if a debug demo-seed is wanted). Remaining mock-parity items NOT in this ticket's scope: calorie ring + macro pills, named-meal "Log as planned" on Hub, streak/notification header (F11), Workout tile (F05).
